newsitem.title: USA: Ralcorp Holdings Inc Q1 Dec 31 net down.
newsitem.headline: Ralcorp Holdings Inc Q1 Dec 31 net down.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q1 1997 net income after restructuring charge of $4.6 million pretax or $2.9 million after-tax.
Q1 1996 net income after restructuring charge of $900,000 pretax or $600,000 after-tax.
Q1 1997 earnings excluding charges $0.49 a share vs $0.46 a year ago.

Pro forma Q1 1997 net loss $1.1 million or $0.03 a share, excluding branded cereal and snack business, which is expected to be sold to Generals Mills Inc, and the divestiture of its ski operations. Pro forma results include $4.6 million pretax restructuring charge and other expenses related to these businesses.
Pro forma Q1 1996 net loss $3.9 million or $0.12 a share, including $900,000 million pretax charge.

Company said pro forma results may not reflect future results because earnings from divested operations are removed but corresponding cost structure associated with supporting larger branded cereal and snack operation has not been removed.
